Two-fix release focused on user-visible polish and the long-standing auto-updater regression. Deferred broker-migration scope to v1.0.28 to ship fast.

### Auto-updater "Check now" button now actually installs

The Bridge tab's "Check now" button has been broken since v1.0.20 (cross-origin between Flask-served dashboard and Tauri webview meant the button could only show a placeholder dialog, not trigger the Rust install path). Fixed via a marker-file IPC bridge:

- `POST /api/update/trigger` writes `%APPDATA%/TradeSpace/update-trigger.txt`
- New Rust watcher polls every 3s, deletes the marker, and runs the same `UpdaterExt::check` + `download_and_install` flow as the v1.0.25 hourly auto-updater
- Dashboard JS calls the new endpoint then shows a tsConfirm explaining what the user will see (download progress, install dialog, restart prompt)

After installing v1.0.27 once via the GitHub release, every subsequent update can be pulled in-app via "Check now" â€” no more manual MSI download.

### What did NOT land in v1.0.27 (deferred to v1.0.28)
